summary: Fixed KAFKA-20434 by adding preferred server assignor change detection to GroupMetadataManager.consumerGroupHeartbeat. When static members of a consumer group rejoin with a different server-side assignor, the group now correctly detects the change in the preferred (majority) assignor and bumps the group epoch to trigger target assignment recomputation. The implementation compares the current preferred assignor with the new preferred assignor after member updates, only considering it a change if there was already a preferred assignor in place (to avoid bumping on initial group creation). Both target tests pass: testStaticMembersRejoinWithDifferentServerAssignor and testStaticMembersRejoinWithNewServerAssignor. All 431 existing tests in GroupMetadataManagerTest pass and all ConsumerGroupHeartbeatRequestTest tests pass.
